assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original transparent modular game-architecture sprite, an OPEN guard-office entrance arch for Synthetic Ascension. Input image 1 is the selected S3 checkpoint CONCEPT reference for architectural character only. Input image 2 is the current city arcade MODULE reference for front-facing camera and material scale only. Create a new SINGLE substantial limestone guard-loggia arch, not the three-bay arcade and not a complete building. Upright south-facing orthographic facade, straight vertical piers, horizontal baseline/coping, mild top-surface visibility matching image 2, no rotated perspective or isometric diamond. Thick squared piers with a plain solid plinth, a deep semicircular or gently flattened stone arch, substantial dark inner side/soffit returns, restrained cornice and quiet broad cool pale limestone faces. Weight and convincing 3D depth should read at 192 px displayed height. Neutral bright northeast daylight with local contact/recess shadows only; no cast shadow outside the sprite. Centre the one arch with the whole masonry silhouette and a small transparent margin. REQUIRED genuine transparent alpha outside the masonry AND through the complete arch opening from its curved intrados down to the baseline; show no black/gray backdrop, gate, door leaf, floor, step or scene through it. The doorway's clear span is about two-thirds of the overall module width, consistent with a real 128 px door plus heavy flanking piers. Quiet stone variation with very few structural joints, no dense outlines, no crumbling holes. No roof, tower, text, signage, cloth/banner, lamp, pipes, ivy, plants, railings, people or other prop. This is a sprite master, not a beauty illustration or a scene crop.
assets.qa: Viewed original; single deep limestone arch, true zero-alpha outside and through opening verified by pixel inspection. Quiet broad faces; full module preserved.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original transparent modular game-architecture sprite, a CLOSED inspection arch bay for Synthetic Ascension's S3 guard-office/loggia. Image 1 is the newly generated open limestone arch reference: match its pale cool stone, heavy piers, restrained coping, broad quiet planes, realistic recessed depth and upright south-facing orthographic facade camera. Image 2 is selected checkpoint concept 03 for family character only; do not copy the scene. Produce ONE narrower CLOSED arched inspection-window bay, taller than wide, with substantial squared side returns, a deep stone semicircular arch and a clearly closed dark iron grille over an opaque muted slate-gray inner backing wall. The bottom is closed by a solid low stone sill/plinth: unmistakably a secured window/inspection bay, never a passable doorway. Balanced width appropriate to display about 160 pixels wide by 192 pixels high. Keep complete isolated masonry silhouette with small transparent margins and no setting. Genuine transparent alpha outside the masonry only; the grilled window interior is deliberately opaque. Bright neutral northeast daylight; broad local recess/contact shadow, no external cast shadow or ambient background wash. Quiet broad cool limestone surfaces with a few large structural joints, softly weathered rather than cracked all over; restrained iron vertical bars and simple horizontal ties, no ornate repeated gothic rail shapes. No open arch hole, floor, steps, roof, tower, text, sign, banner, lamps, pipes, plants, people, terrain or extra bay. This is a single modular original sprite master, not a full building or beauty illustration.
assets.qa: Viewed original; closed iron grille/backing and solid sill distinguish it from an open doorway. Exterior transparency and opaque interior measured; full original preserved.
